answer: A second watch flag will not issue to a pile of fresh aliases at the north tower. A keeper claims one landing by seating a single river stone whose wet mass at 16 C is 82.0 to 84.0 grams on the 1.10-meter cedar tread, then holding the spiral gate at 270 degrees for 48 seconds. A reused stone serial, a mass miss past 0.8 grams, or a second gate key burns the 28.9 POA bond and seals that landing for nine nights.
